name: TOP SQL 分析诊断
description: events_statements_summary_by_digest 是 MySQL 最重要的 SQL 性能分析视图，按 SQL 模式（digest）聚合所有执行的统计信息：执行次数、总耗时、平均耗时、扫描行数、返回行数、临时表使用、排序操作等。通过这个视图可以找到：消耗总资源最多的 SQL（总耗时排序）、单次最慢的 SQL（平均耗时排序）、全表扫描最多的 SQL（SUM_NO_INDEX_USED 排序）。这比 slow log 更全面，因为它包含所有 SQL 而不仅仅是超过 long_query_time 的。

signals.desc: 某个 digest 的 SUM_TIMER_WAIT 显著高于其他
扫描行数远大于返回行数（索引效率低）

conditions.desc: 存在平均耗时 > 100ms 的 SQL

skip_when.desc: P_S 未开启或 statements_digest consumer 关闭
digest 表刚被 TRUNCATE，数据不足

root_causes.name: TOP SQL 缺少索引导致全表扫描
root_causes.desc: TOP SQL 的 SUM_NO_INDEX_USED > 0 且 SUM_ROWS_EXAMINED >> SUM_ROWS_SENT，表示大量全表扫描。添加合适索引可显著改善。

root_causes.name: TOP SQL 返回过多数据
root_causes.desc: SUM_ROWS_SENT 异常高，可能是缺少 LIMIT、查询条件太宽泛、或返回不必要的列（SELECT *）。

root_causes.name: 高频 SQL 单次微慢但累计消耗大
root_causes.desc: 单次执行只需 10-50ms 但每秒执行数百次，总耗时排第一。slow log 无法捕捉这类问题，只有 digest 视图能发现。

root_causes.name: 执行计划变化导致突然变慢
root_causes.desc: SQL 之前很快但因为统计信息变化、索引变更、数据分布变化导致执行计划改变。对比 FIRST_SEEN 和 LAST_SEEN 的耗时变化可以发现。

step1_top_by_total_time.desc: 按总耗时排序的 TOP SQL
step1_top_by_total_time.sql: SELECT DIGEST_TEXT, COUNT_STAR AS exec_count, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT/1e12, 2) AS total_sec, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT/1e9, 2) AS avg_ms, SUM_ROWS_EXAMINED AS rows_examined, SUM_ROWS_SENT AS rows_sent, SUM_NO_INDEX_USED AS full_scans, SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES AS tmp_disk FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 10

step2_top_by_avg_time.desc: 按平均耗时排序的 TOP SQL（最慢的单次查询）
step2_top_by_avg_time.sql: SELECT DIGEST_TEXT, COUNT_STAR AS exec_count, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT/1e9, 2) AS avg_ms, ROUND(MAX_TIMER_WAIT/1e9, 2) AS max_ms, SUM_ROWS_EXAMINED / GREATEST(COUNT_STAR, 1) AS avg_rows_examined FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE COUNT_STAR > 10 ORDER BY AVG_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 10

step3_top_by_full_scan.desc: 全表扫描最多的 TOP SQL
step3_top_by_full_scan.sql: SELECT DIGEST_TEXT, COUNT_STAR AS exec_count, SUM_NO_INDEX_USED AS full_scans, SUM_ROWS_EXAMINED AS rows_examined, SUM_ROWS_SENT AS rows_sent, ROUND(SUM_ROWS_EXAMINED / GREATEST(SUM_ROWS_SENT, 1), 1) AS scan_ratio FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE SUM_NO_INDEX_USED > 0 ORDER BY SUM_ROWS_EXAMINED DESC LIMIT 10

step4_top_by_tmp_disk.desc: 使用磁盘临时表最多的 TOP SQL
step4_top_by_tmp_disk.sql: SELECT DIGEST_TEXT, COUNT_STAR, SUM_CREATED_TMP_TABLES AS tmp_mem, SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES AS tmp_disk, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT/1e12, 2) AS total_sec FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES > 0 ORDER BY SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES DESC LIMIT 10

step5_digest_detail.desc: 查看特定 digest 的详细统计

step6_overall_summary.desc: 总体 SQL 执行概览
step6_overall_summary.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_digests, SUM(COUNT_STAR) AS total_executions, ROUND(SUM(SUM_TIMER_WAIT)/1e12, 2) AS total_seconds, ROUND(SUM(SUM_TIMER_WAIT)/SUM(COUNT_STAR)/1e9, 2) AS overall_avg_ms FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest

real_world_examples.scenario: slow log 中没有慢查询但数据库负载很高
real_world_examples.symptoms: long_query_time=1s，slow_log 几乎为空。但 Threads_running=45，CPU 使用率 80%
real_world_examples.root_cause: 通过 events_statements_summary_by_digest 发现一条 SELECT 单次只需 30ms（不触发 slow log），但每秒执行 5000 次，总耗时占 60%。该查询对一个 200 万行的表做范围扫描，每次扫描 2000 行返回 10 行
real_world_examples.resolution: 添加覆盖索引后单次执行从 30ms 降到 0.5ms，rows_examined 从 2000 降到 10
real_world_examples.result: CPU 使用率从 80% 降到 25%，Threads_running 从 45 降到 8
